UPDATE scheduled_action_draft SET
                checked = $3,
                passed = CASE WHEN $5 THEN $3 ELSE passed END,
                checks = checks + 1,
                created = (
                    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT item), '[]')
                    FROM jsonb_array_elements(created || $4::jsonb) AS item
                )
            WHERE session_id = $1 AND owner_id = $2
